findings.page: /game/prize-draw/join/ reveal flow, card screen and its result
findings.summary: chooseRule accepts a tap only on the card screen, and the choice is stored in localStorage; renderFlow draws no later screen that names the rule tapped, and the out screen has no form. One tap on two equal gold buttons fixes the round's fate on the phone, and a wrong 'out' ends its flow. Degraded task: learning one's own result. Workaround: the main screen, which stays the authority. The tap is decision 13's stated cost (gh#299 last comment). No ruling on undo was found in gh#299 (body and 3 comments), gh#300 (body and comment), gh#309 (body), the source comments or the ADRs

findings.summary: typed digits show as one run ('111111111'); the board's field draws them grouped ('482 915 370') and the projector groups them, so a 12-digit run is compared by eye against '4671 9292 2925'. codeForm only switches the size class past 9 digits; nothing inserts group spaces. No test, comment, ADR or ticket read (gh#299, gh#300, gh#309) gives a reason for the raw field. A mistype is caught by the check digit, so the cost is a retype
findings.fixHereValueSource: 12 digits: Gh302Phone reveal-code-card caption (PICKED 2026-11-11), 'grouped 4-4-4 like the projector. At 320 the field shows them at 26px with 1px letter spacing so the three groups stay apart on one line' (the 26px size is already built). 9 digits: Gh302Phone reveal-code and reveal-wrong A field values '482 915 307' / '482 915 370', and Gh302Projector ROUND CODE caption 'grouped 3-3-3'. The final's 7-digit code has no picked phone value (frame 4's 4-3 is a NEW VALUE row with no PICKED stamp), so it stays ungrouped unless the owner extends 4-3. normaliseDigits (src/prize-draw/round-code.ts) skips spaces and hyphens, so a grouped value parses; the fix's own test confirms it

findings.page: /game/prize-draw/play/ code card, MC controls in the play band
findings.summary: with the code card open, the band's exit X sits where a modal close usually is and the card's real close (ok button) is at the opposite end. The X paints #ffffff, full opacity, not its disabled 0.55 look (read from paint, not a click), and it leaves for the home page with no confirm. Owner rulings: one exit in the same corner on every play route (gh#143, gh#144), not a leave-confirm (PlayExit's header), the 56px band (gh#268, PlayTopBand B). Cost: the room sees the home page; returning to the play route resumes the stored step, so minor

findings.summary: codeClosed is held in memory and nothing reopens the card; control returns no button on the final's result. A round code returns in the next card's earlier list, the final's 7-digit code never does, so a finalist who had not typed it gets no claim screen. This falls short of the condition that phones enter every code in order and the main screen keeps earlier codes visible (gh#299 last comment; frame 4 calls it gh#300 condition 1) for the final. A reload reopens the card: inferred (memory-only flag, and the gh309 pass shows the card open after reloads; nobody closed a card and then reloaded). Staff still match winners on the projector. Cost: a reload that resumes, so minor
